Name: Seasonal Deluxe Scarecrow and Misc Objects Redesigned
Author: SugarSugarRuin
Description:
Recoloured the vanilla deluxe scarecrow specifically to match with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/687]Darker Wood and Gold Craftables[/url] by Eemie.

**************************************************************************************************************************************************************

[b]What this mod does:[/b] (see preview images)

1) A seasonal deluxe scarecrow!
2) A sturdy workbench! (toggle on/off in config.json; default: on)
3) Pretty, round garden pots! (toggle on/off in config.json; default: on)
4) An industrial-looking, machine-like crystalarium! (toggle on/off in config.json; default: on)
